prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Production animation sprite sheet for Wacha Wacha Town. The supplied reference contains FOUR existing characters, top to bottom, each shown in two original poses. Create new poses of EXACTLY these four people, one person per row. Preserve each face, body proportions, skin tone, hairstyle, hat, accessories, outfit construction and EXACT clothing colors. No redesigns or recolors. Match their crisp hand-painted storybook chibi rendering and gentle overhead three-quarter perspective. True transparent alpha background. No floor, scenery, stairs, labels, text, grid lines or shadows under feet. Every cell has generous empty gutters and complete head, hands and feet. Keep fixed character scale and foot baseline across a row; animate limbs and posture, do not translate the character across cells. EXACT GRID: FOUR equal rows by EIGHT equal columns, 32 separate sprites. Each row is one expressive, coherent EIGHT-FRAME seamless loop of the stated role action, with clear anticipation, contact/effort, follow-through and recovery. Hands interact convincingly at waist/chest height with portable tools or an unseen counter in front-right. Keep the original portable tools; do not attach a large counter, building, chair or floor to the sprite. Facing front-right three-quarter. Make genuinely different body poses, not identical copies. Landscape canvas, ideally 1536 by 1024. Stage: 花咲くガーデン. Stage locations: 温室|苗販売所|噴水広場|バラのアーチ|庭師小屋の2階|池の桟橋|芝生の休憩所|養蜂区画.
Row 1: S02-C081, 庭園の入場係 1; action context: 券を切って渡す.
Row 2: S02-C086, レモネード店員 1; action context: 飲み物を注ぐ.
Row 3: S02-C091, 巣箱を直す職人 1; action context: 鳥の巣箱を整える.
Row 4: S02-C096, 花咲くガーデンのカメラマン 1; action context: 写真を撮る.
LOOP CONTINUITY LOCK: Treat the LEFT reference pose as the authority for the face, body and clothing; the RIGHT pose supplies the role tool. Hold the SAME tools and SAME colors/count of all portable props in ALL EIGHT frames, including frame 8. Never finish by switching to the empty-handed walking reference. Use small continuous hand, wrist, elbow, knee, hip and head movements around the fixed tool; pose 8 must naturally return to pose 1. Do not make props disappear/reappear or randomly recolor. Do not change a finished product into raw material within this short loop. For juggling or balloon work, every frame has exactly the same balls/balloons in the same colors, only positions change. A camera, paddle, net, watering can or steering wheel stays visible through the complete cycle.
notes: 4×8コマと4人の同一性を確認。row4カメラの上下とシャッター動作は全8コマで同じカメラを維持し採用。
row1ハサミが6コマ目で消失、row2ピッチャーが6コマ目で消失、row3巣箱が2コマ目で消失するため3行は不採用。
